title: Pipe Dream
summary: Load dplyr, chain steps with |>, and keep the rows and columns you need with filter() and select().
hints: `astronauts |> filter(year_of_mission >= 2010) |> select(name, nationality, year_of_mission, hours_mission)`. `select()` keeps columns in the order you list them.
Two conditions in one `filter()`, separated by a comma, must both be true: `filter(sex == "female", hours_mission > 4000)`.
